name: DAAD RISE worldwide
description: Research internships in Germany for students in science and engineering fields, organised by the German Academic Exchange Service (DAAD). Check the official page for who can apply and the application period.

name: Mitacs Globalink Research Internship
description: Research internships at Canadian universities for international undergraduate students from partner countries. Check the official page for eligible countries and dates.

name: Erasmus+ traineeships
description: Funded traineeships abroad for students and recent graduates, arranged through your university's international office. Eligibility depends on your university and country.

name: CERN Summer Student Programme
description: Summer programme at CERN (Geneva) for undergraduate students in physics, engineering and computing. Check the official page for eligibility and dates.

name: ESA student and graduate opportunities
description: Traineeships for students and young graduates at ESA establishments in Europe. Nationality rules apply: check the official page.

name: European Commission traineeships (Blue Book)
description: Paid traineeships at the European Commission for university graduates. Check the official page for conditions and application periods.

name: European Parliament traineeships
description: Traineeships at the European Parliament. Check the official page for the types of traineeship and who can apply.

name: United Nations internships
description: Internships across United Nations offices worldwide, posted individually on UN Careers. Students and recent graduates can apply to the postings that match their field.

name: World Health Organization internships
description: Internships at WHO, mainly in Geneva, for graduate and final-year students. Check the official page for the conditions.

name: OECD internships
description: Internships at the OECD in Paris. Check the careers page for current openings and requirements.

name: IAESTE technical internships
description: International exchange of paid technical internships for engineering and science students, run through national IAESTE committees in more than 80 countries. Apply through your country's committee.

name: AIESEC global internships
description: Youth organisation offering professional and volunteer internships abroad, arranged through your local AIESEC committee.
